items.headline: DeChambeau’s U.S. Open Chances Doubtful
items.text: Bryson DeChambeau faces uncertainty over winning the U.S. Open at Shinnecock Hills this week amid LIV Golf controversies.

items.headline: Brooks Koepka’s Nerve Flare-Up
items.text: Brooks Koepka experiences an ulnar nerve flare-up causing numbness in his left fingers but will tee off at 7:30 a.m. Thursday after negative neck scans.
